basics.name: Aniket Mishra
basics.label: Physics Major, IISER Kolkata
basics.summary: BS-MS student at IISER Kolkata majoring in Earth Sciences. Interested in stellar evolution, numerical simulations, and data-driven science. Currently working on MESA-based stellar modeling and other computational projects in physics.

education.institution: Alpha Junior College Of Science and Commerce

projects.name: Modeling Stellar Structure and Evolution
projects.summary: A computational study using MESA to simulate stars of varying mass and metallicity. Results analyzed through HR diagrams and temperature-density profiles. Interactive web atlas and open dataset published.

projects.name: A Study on Hysteresis Loop
projects.summary: Used Ubermag (Python interface to OOMMF) to simulate hysteresis loops under different exchange energy configurations in a cubic system.
